meta.name: claude-agent-sdk-typescript
meta.description: Expert guidance for building AI agents with the Claude Agent SDK in TypeScript/JavaScript. Use when the user writes TypeScript or JavaScript code with the SDK, imports from "@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk", uses query(), allowedTools, permissionMode, creates custom tools with createSdkMcpServer, sets up hooks, integrates MCP servers, manages sessions, or debugs SDK issues in TypeScript/Node.js. Also triggers on: "@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk", "allowedTools", "permissionMode", "npm install", "for await", "AgentDefinition", or "settingSources".
